list.label: Metric
list.description: Hidden: every metric of this kind with data in the selected time range, in category order. The page repeats one chart per metric.
list.query: SELECT initcap(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.category, 'unknown'), 'other')) || ' · ' || COALESCE(r.display_name, m.metric) || COALESCE(' (' || CASE r.unit_canonical WHEN 'degC' THEN '°C' WHEN 'dBASPL' THEN 'dB' WHEN 'km/hr' THEN 'km/h' WHEN 'count/min' THEN CASE m.metric WHEN 'respiratory_rate' THEN 'breaths/min' ELSE 'bpm' END WHEN 'count' THEN NULL ELSE NULLIF(r.unit_canonical, '') END || ')', '') AS __text, m.metric AS __value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT metric FROM daily_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter((day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz'))) m LEFT JOIN metric_registry r USING (metric) WHERE COALESCE(r.agg_default, 'avg') = 'sum' ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(r.category, 'unknown'), 'zz'), 1

options.content:
Every measure your devices sent in the selected time range, one chart each, grouped by kind. Nothing to choose: a measure your watch doesn't record simply isn't listed, and older watches report fewer.

Totals are things that add up (steps, exercise minutes, energy): each day is a bar from zero. Measurements are things that are measured (heart rate, walking speed): each day is a point on a line, the day's average, or the lowest reading for resting heart rate. The dashed line is the 7-day average, which shows the trend under the day-to-day noise.

Heart rate variability (HRV) is how much the time between heartbeats varies; it runs higher when you're rested and is very personal, so compare it with your own history, not other people's. Resting heart rate is the lowest steady rate of the day. Walking asymmetry and double support come from the iPhone in your pocket: how evenly you step, and how much of each stride both feet are on the ground.

panels.title: $total
panels.description: Each day's value (bars) and the 7-day average (dashed).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz') AS time,
  CASE COALESCE(r.agg_default, 'avg') WHEN 'sum' THEN d.sum WHEN 'min' THEN d.vmin WHEN 'max' THEN d.vmax ELSE d.avg END AS "Daily",
  AVG(CASE COALESCE(r.agg_default, 'avg') WHEN 'sum' THEN d.sum WHEN 'min' THEN d.vmin WHEN 'max' THEN d.vmax ELSE d.avg END)
    OVER (ORDER BY d.day RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '6 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "7-day average"
FROM daily_metrics d LEFT JOIN metric_registry r USING (metric)
WHERE d.metric IN (${total:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter((day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE '$tz'))
ORDER BY d.day

defaults.noValue: Not reported by your devices in this range
